changes_made: OAuth2HandlerService.redirectToIDPLoginPage(): generate crypto.randomUUID() state before IdP redirect, store in sessionStorage['oidc_state'], append state to IdP URL as query parameter
RouteGuardService.canActivate(): validate route.queryParams.state against sessionStorage['oidc_state'] before any OIDC code exchange — reject with redirect to webLogin on mismatch
sessionStorage['oidc_state'] also cleaned up on redirect error path

files_modified.changes: redirectToIDPLoginPage(): added crypto.randomUUID() state generation, sessionStorage.setItem('oidc_state', state), URL state parameter append before window.location.href assignment. Error path: sessionStorage.removeItem('oidc_state').
canActivate(): added state validation block — reads route.queryParams.state and sessionStorage['oidc_state'], calls removeItem to consume, rejects with router.navigate(['webLogin']) on mismatch.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: CSRF state parameter: cryptographically random UUID generated per OIDC flow, validated before code exchange. RFC 6749 §10.12 compliant. Any code injection attempt without a matching state is rejected before the code is forwarded to ApplinX.
secondary_controls: VULN-009 fix: sessionStorage.setItem('idPcode', code) removed — code is no longer persisted, reducing the stale artifact attack surface
VULN-007 fix (same file): redirectUri validated for https:// scheme before navigation
Recommend implementing PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) as an additional binding layer
detection: State mismatch logged as error: 'OIDC state mismatch — possible CSRF attack. Aborting code exchange.'
response: On state mismatch, user is redirected to webLogin — session not established

validation_criteria: CSRF code injection: crafted URL with valid code but no/wrong state → rejected, user redirected to webLogin
Legitimate OIDC flow: state generated, appended to IdP URL, validated on callback → exchange proceeds
State consumed after use — replay of same state URL rejected

test_cases.name: CSRF attack — code without matching state
test_cases.expected: canActivate() rejects: route.queryParams.state !== sessionStorage['oidc_state'] → navigate to webLogin, return false
test_cases.actual: State validation check fires, mismatch detected, user redirected

test_cases.name: Legitimate OIDC callback
test_cases.expected: State matches — code exchange proceeds normally

regression_tests.name: OIDC login flow completes end-to-end with valid state
